title: solanum villosum subsp. ochroleucum
intro: Solanum villosum subsp. ochroleucum, commonly known as the yellow-fruited bittersweet nightshade, is a plant species that belongs to the Solanaceae family. It is native to Asia and has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Solanum villosum subsp. ochroleucum include glycosides, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
